head: Google Photos save as copy only on some Galaxy phones after One UI 9
dek: On some Samsung Galaxy phones with One UI 9, Google Photos only offers "Save as copy" after an edit, even a simple crop, so every change leaves a second photo. Android Authority saw it on a Galaxy S23 FE; owners also report it on the Galaxy A35, S26 and Z Fold 8 Ultra.
details: The normal Save option is gone, also from the three-dot menu, for camera photos, screenshots and downloaded pictures. One Fold 8 Ultra owner says it started after an "Updating Photo Editor" notice. Similar reports go back to September and grew in November. Samsung has reportedly passed it to its engineers; Google hasn't commented, and it's unclear whether it's a bug or a change.
where: Some Galaxy phones on One UI 9, Google Photos
means: If you edit photos on a Galaxy phone, each edit may now leave the original and a copy, which takes up storage.
todo: For now, delete the extra copies you don't need after editing. There's no official fix yet.
thumb_words: GOOGLE PHOTOS: SAVE AS COPY ONLY
